t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The player tried to figure out which gnome gave him the highest number of mushrooms by looking at the colours and then carried on selecting this combination until he was getting low or zero numbers.  He then switched to the other gnome.  He did this on multiple occasions.  He found that red,pink and purple colours worked best for him but acknowledged that it may be different for other players.

vb_textbox.text: There are two themes of colours, purple, pink, brown and blue yellow and green.  Sometimes the pink purple group will get the most points and other times the blue yellow group.  If you keep playing eventually the best group will start giving lower points.  At this point switch to the other combination until the same thing happens again and you start getting lower points.  Keep playing and trying the different combinations.
